name: Bing Image Creator
tagline: Bing Image Creator is Microsoft's free text-to-image tool, powered by DALL-E 3 and accessible directly in the Bing search interface and Microsoft Edge sidebar. It generates four high-quality images per prompt at no cost, making it the most accessible entry point to DALL-E 3-quality generation for mainstream users. With no subscription required and deep Windows integration, it's used daily by hundreds of millions of Microsoft users.
